description: Prepare a repay on a Morpho Blue market. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the repay tx. Supports "max" for full repayment. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

amount.description: Loan token amount to repay in human-readable decimals (e.g., "100"), or "max" for full repayment

name: morpho_prepare_repay
